limitations: All numbers are observed prefixes for stated paths, not complete400-byte HID or750-byte APP stack bounds. ROM, allocator internals, deeper RTOS/ICall helpers, scheduler frames and IRQ preemption are not fully measured.
The core/worker maximum, BLE API seam depths and expanded native ICall prefixes describe different paths. Do not add the reported maxima together or add34B8/3322 frames again where already included.

The expanded native paths stop inside a call before return, so their callee-saved/SP restoration field is null; complete-return ABI assertions are established separately.
The gate instruction counts cover the measured finite scenarios. They do not quantify hardware latency or prove a worst-case interrupt-off duration.
The UART/Clock callback atomicity review relies on the native task/Swi and nonblocking Event_post contracts. No real RTOS scheduler, radio, deep sleep or hardware reconnect behavior is emulated.
This report does not establish a cause for earlier hardware connection delays or authorize a device flash.
